title: 2022 Panini Score #SA-BS Bruce Smith Sack Attack Buffalo Bills
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2022 Panini Score trading card featuring Bruce Smith of the Buffalo Bills. It is part of the Sack Attack Red insert set, specifically card number SA-BS. The card showcases Smith's prowess in sacking quarterbacks during his NFL career. It is a collectible sports trading card for football fans and collectors.
